question: Stulz GmbH founded location headquarters
markdown:
STULZ GmbH, founded in 1947 in Hamburg by Albert Stulz, is a family-owned manufacturer of mission-critical cooling and precision air conditioning systems. Its headquarters are at Holsteiner Chaussee 283, 22457 Hamburg, Germany, and it operates as a GmbH & Co. KG with revenue around $1.5 billion.
STULZ GmbH was founded in 1947 in Hamburg, Germany.
The founder was Albert Stulz, originally as Electro AS GmbH Hamburg.
Headquarters location: Holsteiner Chaussee 283, 22457 Hamburg, Germany.
Core business: mission-critical cooling and precision air conditioning systems.
STULZ is a family-owned company.
STULZ is a GmbH & Co. KG.
Industry: manufacturing.
The first product was "Piccolo" (vacuum, polisher, food processor).
Hamburg is the mother plant and global engineering center.
Revenue is approximately $1.5 billion.
